**The repository is the persistent versioned authority; Notion is the operational layer; Google Drive is not a storage authority** (decision `D7`). **Prompt bodies are authored and revised in Notion in place and are never mirrored into the repository.** The Prompt Corpus Storage and Fidelity Policy (Product Owner, 2026-09-21, permanent) prohibits whole-corpus exports, local prompt directories, and byte-identity checks on prompt bodies. Use [Glow HDE Complete Prompt Set — GCFPE-20261009.1 — 100926.1](https://app.notion.com/p/@CATALOG_PAGE_ID) and this register for every actual selected destination. The final [CL-40 — 100926.1](@SUCC_URL:CL-40) scan uses its real closure intake and returns terminally to the Product Owner. How a change to this ecosystem is made routine — the five-step lifecycle, the defect-class catalogue, the standing instruments and the definition of done — is `docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/ecosystem-change-management.md`, which is normative. Skill changes follow `docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/skill-packaging-and-delivery.md`: **no skill change is trusted until a party that did not author it has validated it**, and a verdict is scoped to exact bytes and does not carry. Post-flight follows `docs/prompt_ecosystem_management/postflight-procedure.md`.
Preserve one continuing maintenance owner, bounded impact dispositions for every member, actual validation and publication evidence, and the existing error log.
